Sorry, missed it. I'm not super familiar with ArduPilot, so I'm not sure yet what the issue is. But first can you high level describe what you're trying to do? That might help me to actually help you or suggest something.

> Sorry, missed it. I'm not super familiar with ArduPilot, so I'm not sure yet what the issue is. But first can you high level describe what you're trying to do? That might help me to actually help you or suggest something.

Sure, essentially it's about creating a mini GCS with some additional customized features. First, I need to get the real-time values from each output channel and display them on my GCS UI. Then, I also need the ability to control the outputs in real-time. There’s a function called override_rc in mavros that directly overrides RC input, and I used that to achieve it. However, the delay with mavros is a bit high, which is why I switched to MAVSDK.
You can use direct RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE if you want, using the MavlinkDirect plugin.

> You can use direct RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE if you want, using the MavlinkDirect plugin.

So how to use "actuator_output_status()", its only reply "ActuatorOutputStatus:   active: 0" here.
And what is the function of "set_actuator()".
I am using MAVSDK lib but not mavlink_v2 lib is that I just don't want to facing the low level mavlink..

MavlinkDirect is JSON based without MAVLink v2 C headers.

Here is what gets assembled:

https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/4086878d076141e6193ed7585ae4339ce8496361/src/mavsdk/plugins/telemetry/telemetry_impl.cpp#L1328-L1348

@julianoes 
So can you please have a look of the original issue that "actuator_output_status() and set_actuator() not work on arduPilot" at the situation of the describe as I publish in the front.

I'm not usually using ArduPilot, so this will need some convincing. If you can give me a small example that I can use to reproduce the problem, together with instructions what to do with ArduPilot SITL, then that would certainly make it easier for me. Thanks.

issue.body:
The Action have API:
`goto_location (double latitude_deg, double longitude_deg, float absolute_altitude_m, float yaw_deg)const`
And Offboard have API:
`set_position_global(PositionGlobalYaw position_global_yaw) const;`

The Action have API:
`set_actuator (int32_t index, float value)const`
And Offboard have API:
`set_actuator_control(ActuatorControl actuator_control) const;`

What are the different of them??

And, is there a way to directly ctrl the ch out? For the situation of no position info(No gps .etc), just like using a hand hold "Remote control"!!
Or there is a way to orerride the "RCin" like the node "rc/override" in mavros!!!


And, calling ManualControl::start_position_control() in my ardupilot rover SITL, it print err:
`[04:34:42|Error] Cannot translate flight mode to ArduPilot Rover mode. (system_impl.cpp:925)`
and change to ardupilot ArduCopter, its not print err
And this ManualControl::start_position_control() says its need position info such as GPS fixed, so what is the way to simu "using a hand hold "Remote control"!!"...
